wiki.title: Mike Harris (Michigan politician)
wiki.extract: Mike Harris (born March 16, 1973) is an American law enforcement officer, businessman, and politician serving as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives since 2022, currently representing the 52nd district. He is a member of the Republican Party.
